title: 73% AI-linked. Apparently I’m betting on this harder than I thought.
author: SaucyBossy1919
selftext:
My portfolio came back 73% AI-linked. That honestly shook me a little.  
Bullish or bearish, I don’t like being surprised by how much of the same story I own.  
I built https://trygalore.com to look into this: US stock/ETF weights or values; completely free.
It counts whole AI-linked companies, not AI revenue or likely losses; missing evidence stays unknown.
